plan.rationale: Frozen objective is ttft_ms for the interactive row (batch=1, 256 prompt tokens) of a single-GPU eager Qwen3-4B BF16 SDPA inference step, bounded by prefill + argmax + explicit synchronize. The torch collector already ran with complete attribution (66441/66441 kernels associated, 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous sequences, 0 autograd ranges), so it is not re-requested and no overlap, graph-tracing or attribution question remains for nsys. Communication is not_applicable (single-device task), ruling out nccl_tuning and collective_calibration; device_telemetry offers only device-wide native-window readings that cannot be attributed to the prefill region. The open TTFT questions are (a) how the start-to-synchronize wall time splits into CPU submit spans, launch/queue gaps and GPU execution intervals, and (b) host dispatch and legacy-binding cost of the 36-layer eager Python forward loop (transformers 5.16.1, no torch.compile, per-layer Python dispatch verified in the measured environment). execution_timeline supplies submit associations, synchronization events, per-device/region intervals and clock-alignment bounds for the prefill region; python_runtime supplies a warmed cProfile host call trace (self/inclusive/counts) for dispatch and binding hot spots, used diagnostically only since it perturbs execution. Neither collector replaces a measurement path nor alters the workload, correctness checks or the frozen ttft boundary.
